# nd_switch_config_diff (Data Source)

Returns a line-by-line comparison of a switch's running configuration and the configuration expected by the fabric.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nd_switch_config_diff" "test_datasource_switch_config_diff_1" {
  fabric_name = "fabric1"
  switch_id   = "9VHGPK71R8X"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `fabric_name` (String) Name of the fabric whose expected switch's configuration is used for the comparison.
- `switch_id` (String) ID of the switch whose running configuration is compared with the fabric's expected configuration.

### Read-Only

- `diff_configs` (Attributes List) Ordered line-by-line comparison for the selected switch. Each entry identifies whether a command matches, is missing from the running configuration, or is extra in the running configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--diff_configs))

<a id="nestedatt--diff_configs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `diff_configs`

Read-Only:

- `difference_type` (String) Comparison result: equal means the running and expected lines match; insert means the line exists in expected configuration but not running configuration; delete means it exists in running configuration but not expected configuration.
- `expected_config` (String) Configuration command expected on the switch by the fabric. Empty when this difference has no corresponding expected line, such as a delete.
- `running_config` (String) Configuration command currently present in the switch's running configuration. Empty when this difference has no corresponding running line, such as an insert.
